summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it, chmods 0755, and then uses `execFileSync` to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` under the fetched Bun binary — with no hash or signature verification on either artifact. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with hex-mangled identifiers and a rotated string-array decoder, unrelated to the plugin's advertised purpose (a small ESLint rule; `dist/index.js` is only ~1.7KB). The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope and points its repository at `github.com/servicetitan/uikit`, but the legitimate uikit source tree does not contain `setup.mjs` or `math_init.js`. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload at install is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based scanners, and it grants the payload full-host code execution on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
